policy.zone_veto: one-sided exact McNemar p across the four non-roof adventure zones; Holm–Bonferroni step-down correction, family-wise alpha = 0.05; veto while ordered p < 0.05 / (group_count - rank + 1)
policy.seed_assignment: 1728 adventure pairs evenly divided: first 18 tasks take 46, remaining 20 take 45
policy.seed_reuse: never; ledger-allocated contiguous block per round, exhaustion aborts the gate instead of wrapping
policy.incumbent_rerun: both sides are evaluated on the round seeds; cached incumbent outcomes are never used
policy.panel: adventure levels (original 1.0x, scoreboard decks) where the r11 student or the teacher has a recorded win; all-loss cells carry no regression signal
policy.heldout: monitor only: 96 pairs each, written into the round report, never vetoes and never enters the overall rate

roof_veto.test: one-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, alternative less
roof_veto.unit: roof zone, pooling both tasks (90 pairs)
roof_veto.distribution: exact conditional sign-flip, inclusive lower tail
